inputs.name: script
inputs.type: t:вЂ¦ (a type with the code control)

200.description: The new node. config: {title, inputs: [{id, name, type?}], outputs: [{id, name, type?}], op? (what the node does: script, on_run, on_read, on_placed, on_deleted, on_input_connected, on_widget; none: it holds the values typed into its outputs), widgets? (the widgets the node has: [{id, kind, label?, value?, ...}])}. A port of type `signal` carries no data: a signal output goes to every wire, and a signal input starts the node. A Script (op script) has exactly the signal input `in` and the code input `script`, and the signal output `out`, emitted automatically after successful completion: it runs the code when a signal reaches it, and the code reads the data inputs of the Library node it is in (node.input.name), writes its free outputs (node.output.name) and fires its free signal outputs (node.output.name.emit()).

200.description: Widget kinds: text, textarea, number, checkbox, select (options), range (min, max, step), button (its value counts clicks), label (text), html (html, height; shown in a sandboxed frame). A widget that stays keeps its value unless the list gives one.

put.summary: A person changed widgets of a node: sets the values and calls on_widget of the node
A person typed into the control of a free input: sets the value (the default of the input) on the node; null takes it away
A person typed into the control of an output that shows one (`editable`): sets the value the node holds there, which is its output until its code sets another; null takes it away
